items: [Powerful Bluetooth 5.0 Technology] - Powerful bluetooth 3.0/5.0 technology, connects up to 3 BT devices at the same time. Switch devices easily with Fn+1/2/3. Compatible with MacOS, Win, iOS and Android. Switch the system by pressing Fn+Q/W/E/R according to the connected device. Support iPad, iPhone, iMac, Macbook, laptop, tablet, smartphone. *Note: ONLY supports Bluetooth connection, DO NOT supports 2.4Ghz wireless.

[Integrated Stand for iPad & iPhone] - Built in a groove holder for iPad/iPhone/tablet/cellphone with comfortable viewing angle. The groove size is 10.6*0.6*0.55in (27*1.5*1.4cm). Please note that the 12.9-inch iPad Pro can only be place vertically. This ergonomic keyboard includes adjustable feet not only alleviate pressure on your wrist from typing at an elevated angle, but also make the keyboard more stable.

[Battery Powered & Energy-Saving] - Powered by 2 AAA batteries included. With low-power chip and energy-saving technology, it can last up to 3-6 months depending on usage. The keyboard goes to Shallow Sleep Mode in 2 mins of sitting idle to save battery, and Deep Sleep Mode in 30 mins, press any key to wake up.

[Aesthetic Silent Bluetooth Keyboard] - The bluetooth keyboard comes with aesthetic design and silent switches. Light and responsive tactile keystroke makes typing soft and comfortable. The sound is quiet when the button is pressed lightly. Suitable for various occasions such as office, meeting, travel, business trip, classroom, library, etc.

[Compact & Portable] - Compact 79 keys layout, saves about 25% space compared to full-size keyboards. It frees up workspace on your desk while retaining most of the necessary buttons. Portable and lightweight (11.9*6.1*1.1in, 1.1lb). Convenient to carry when you are on business or traveling.
